news.t: PS Medico v19.0 (build 40, 20 Nov 2026): the one-app edition - the FULL app (254,251 medicines, every feature) now runs at the PS Medico web address too, always the newest version. While online: prices re-check themselves while you search, and a medicine not in the catalog is found on the internet and added automatically. Maker scores and lab badges are gone (owner's choice) - facts only: prices with dates, warnings, the batch checker. Cleaner look, fewer words.

PS Medico build 39 (20 Nov 2026): the live-price update - the whole community price list re-checked against PharmEasy (12277 medicines now carry 20 Nov 2026 MRPs), thousands of medicines the app never had added with composition + today's MRP, and (after the server update) prices refresh themselves while you search. The keyboard fix from build 37 is included.
